name: 3TS Capital Partners

entity_kind.quote: 3TS Capital Partners is a technology-focused growth equity firm that invests across Europe in sectors such as technology, media, and technology-enabled services.

investor_type.quote: 3TS is an established technology growth-stage VC firm in Central Europe and Eastern Europe and will contribute to technological and industrial innovation capital in the region.

sectors.quote: With Fund IV, 3TS will continue to back rapidly growing technology companies across software, tech-enabled services, and e-commerce sectors, by leading investment rounds of €5-20M.

stages.quote: 3TS Capital Partners, a European technology-focused growth capital investor, has announced the first closing of its Fund IV with a target size of €150M.
